chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Malik ibn Atiyyah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who married a woman upon a house in a property belonging to him, while he had partners in that property. He said: “It is permissible for him and for her, and none of the partners has any right of pre-emption against her.”

key_terms.بَيْتٍ: a house or dwelling given in the marriage arrangement
key_terms.دَارٍ: a property or residence complex in which the house is located
key_terms.شُرَكَاءُ: co-owners or partners in the property
key_terms.شُفْعَةَ: the right of pre-emption held by a co-owner in certain sales

ai.seo_question: If a man gives a house in jointly owned property as part of marriage, do the partners have a right of shuf‘ah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning marriage settlement involving a house within jointly owned property. It states that such an arrangement is valid between the spouses, and that the co-owners do not possess a right of shuf‘ah against the wife in this case.
